title: The Bear
synopsis: Forty covers. Three line cooks. One temperamental pilot light. Don't burn it.

nodes.text: Sydney pulls a list. The walk-in is colder than yesterday. Richie is late.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Discipline.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Mercy—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Two cases of tomatoes. The herbs are good. The pilot light isn't.

nodes.text: You write tomorrow's prep at the cold pass.

nodes.text: Months later the inspector arrives. Star, half. The kitchen, for a beat, cries together. Then Sydney calls service.
You don't get the star. You get something almost as rare: a kitchen full of people who like coming back tomorrow.
Carmy takes a step back. You and Sydney run the line cleaner without him. He drops in on Thursdays to taste.
